headline.purpose: Incident type at the top of the panel; focus target when a row opens.

body-strong.purpose: Button labels, row titles, fact values.

small.purpose: Queue why lines (max 2 lines), timeline text.

label.purpose: Uppercase section headers and fact keys.

mono-sm.purpose: Band badges, concept labels, small counts.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Only for floating things: toasts, tooltips, the popover, the phone action bar.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.value: outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--focus-halo)
shadows.purpose: Shared focus-visible ring on every interactive element.

motion.purpose: Processing arc; static under reduced motion.

motion.name: row-highlight

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one recommended action per panel.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary { border: none; background: var(--accent, #84b926); color: var(--accent-ink, #0a0b0a); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #4a6b22); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--focus-halo, #84b92673); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-secondary { border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #8a8f8a); background: transparent; color: var(--text, #111312); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--sunken, #f2f2f2); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #4a6b22); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--focus-halo, #84b92673); }

components.name: Locked Button
components.description: Disabled or role-locked action, always with its reason.
components.html: Supervisor approval needed
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-btn-locked { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong, #8a8f8a); background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted, #5f645f); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-locked:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #4a6b22); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--focus-halo, #84b92673); } .ds-reason { padding-left: 4px; font: 400 12px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text-2, #3d423e); }

components.name: Priority Bands
components.description: Priority as weight, not hue: solid, outlined, hairline.
components.html: P1 P2 P3
components.css: .ds-band { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 30px; height: 22px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 6px; box-sizing: border-box; font: 600 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-band-p1 { background: var(--p1-bg, #111312); color: var(--p1-fg, #fff); } .ds-band-p2 { border: 1.5px solid var(--p2-line, #111312); color: var(--p2-fg, #111312); } .ds-band-p3 { border: 1px solid var(--p3-line, #bfc3bf); color: var(--p3-fg, #5f645f); font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Status Chips
components.description: Every state is hue plus icon plus word.
components.html: Acknowledged Signal delayed Blocked: station offline
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; font: 500 12px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-sq { border-radius: 6px; } .ds-chip-info { background: var(--info-bg, #e2edf3); color: var(--info, #335f7c); } .ds-chip-unk { background: var(--unk-bg, #f2f2f2); color: var(--unk, #565b57); border: 1px dashed var(--unk-border, #8a8f8a); } .ds-chip-err { background: var(--err-bg, #f9e4e0); color: var(--err, #a8321f); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Type and band filters with a mono count; pressed turns ink.
components.css: .ds-filter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #8a8f8a); background: transparent; color: var(--text, #111312); font: 500 12px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--text, #111312); background: var(--text, #111312); color: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-filter:hover { background: var(--sunken, #f2f2f2); } .ds-filter[aria-pressed="true"]:hover { background: var(--text, #111312); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #4a6b22); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--focus-halo, #84b92673); } .ds-count { font: 500 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; opacity: .75; }

components.name: Queue Row
components.description: The ledger line: band, title, mono countdown, why line with the deciding reason first; breached rows carry a 3 px Err edge.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 4px 12px; width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e8eae8); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #111312); text-align: left; font: 400 14px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border-strong, #8a8f8a); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid var(--accent-text, #4a6b22); outline-offset: -1.5px; background: var(--accent-soft, #eef6df); } .ds-row-band { grid-row: span 2; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 30px; height: 22px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--p1-bg, #111312); color: var(--p1-fg, #fff); font: 600 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-row-title b { font-weight: 500; } .ds-mono { font: 500 13px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--text-2, #3d423e); } .ds-muted { color: var(--text-muted, #5f645f); font-size: 13px; } .ds-row-breach { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--err-bg, #f9e4e0); color: var(--err, #a8321f); font: 600 13px/1 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-row-why { grid-column: 2 / 4; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--text-2, #3d423e); } .ds-row--breached { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--err, #a8321f); } .ds-row-why b { font-weight: 500; color: var(--text, #111312); }

components.name: Inline Confirm
components.description: One-sentence consequence under the action bar; never a modal.
components.html:
Confirm · Retry dispenseMoves PCL-0107 to the hatch at WAL-01. The recipient may be waiting.
Esc to cancel
components.css: .ds-confirm { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; max-width: 640px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #8a8f8a); background: var(--sunken, #f2f2f2); color: var(--text, #111312); font: 400 14px/1.45 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-label { font: 500 12px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted, #5f645f); } .ds-confirm-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-ink { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--text, #111312); color: var(--surface, #fff); font: 500 13px/1 Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-quiet { height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #111312); font: 500 13px/1 Inter, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ink:focus-visible, .ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #4a6b22); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--focus-halo, #84b92673); } .ds-hint { margin-left: auto; font: 400 11px/1 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--text-muted, #5f645f); }

components.name: Network Summary
components.description: Header network status: Offline with an err icon, Signal delayed dashed. Band counts live on the band filter chips, not here.
components.css: .ds-sum { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-sum-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e8eae8); background: transparent; color: var(--text, #111312); font: 500 12px/1 Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sum-btn:hover { background: var(--sunken, #f2f2f2); } .ds-sum-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #4a6b22); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--focus-halo, #84b92673); } .ds-sum-p1 { padding: 3px 4px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--p1-bg, #111312); color: var(--p1-fg, #fff); font: 600 11px/1 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-sum-err { color: var(--err, #a8321f); } .ds-sum-unk { color: var(--unk, #565b57); border: 1px dashed var(--unk-border, #8a8f8a); } .ds-t { color: var(--text, #111312); } .ds-m { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }

narrative.overview:
The console is the record an operator trusts at the end of a long shift. It is calm, plain and accountable: low visual noise, declarative copy, and every line on screen able to say why it is there. A rank shows its reasons, a countdown shows its source, a disabled button shows its excuse, and every action leaves a line in the log. Nothing shouts. Urgency comes through weight, order and a single breach tint, never through alarm colour or motion.

The density is that of a working tool: a 14 px body, 12 px labels, tabular numerals throughout, and JetBrains Mono for anything an operator reads back aloud (IDs, clock times, countdowns). The light theme is a cool paper ledger; the dark theme is the same ledger in Ledger Ink, built for parity rather than as an afterthought. Both themes hold WCAG 2.2 AA.

The brand comes from Delivery One's public website: Inter and JetBrains Mono, pill buttons, and the lime full stop that ends the product name. Inside the tool that lime becomes the Pilot-Light: the one small light that stays on and marks where the operator acts. Controls are tactile and confident, with firm 36 px targets (44 px on touch), solid fills and clear running states.
keyCharacteristics: Ledger calm: flat surfaces, 1 px hairlines, shadows only on things that float.
Priority is weight, not hue: P1 solid, P2 outlined, P3 hairline.
Every state has a shape: hue plus icon plus word, never colour alone.
Uncertainty is its own material: grey, dashed and stamped "as of hh:mm".
One Pilot-Light per panel: the recommended action is the only lime button.

rules.name: The Pilot-Light Rule
rules.body: Lime means "act here" or "you are here", never "healthy". One lime button per panel: the recommended action.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Hue Rule
rules.body: Priority bands carry no colour. P1 is a solid Ledger Ink badge, P2 a 1.5 px ink outline, P3 a hairline in grey. Status hues stay free for state.

rules.name: The Honest Grey Rule
rules.body: Data that may be stale is grey, dashed, carries a clock icon and reads "as of hh:mm". It never borrows the ok style.

rules.name: The Read-Back Rule
rules.body: If an operator would read it aloud to a colleague (an ID, a time, a countdown, a count), set it in JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The 12 px Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing an operator must read is set below 12 px, on desktop or phone.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Rows, panels and blocks never cast shadows. If it scrolls with the page, it is flat.

dos: Do keep the disclaimer footer line ("Independent concept. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Delivery One. Illustrative data.") visible on every screen at every width.
Do keep concept tags (Illustrative, Proposed, Demo control) out of the working screens; they belong in Help and Concept controls.
Do pair every status hue with an icon and a word.
Do set IDs, times, countdowns and counts in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.
Do give every disabled or locked action a visible reason line.
Do show stale values grey and dashed with "as of hh:mm".
Do keep the 2 px focus ring with its 4 px halo on every interactive element.
donts: Don't use lime to mean "healthy", or put more than one lime button in a panel.
Don't give priority bands a hue; a red P1 would read as Offline or Breached.
Don't add shadows to rows, panels or blocks.
Don't use modals or browser dialogs for confirmation.
Don't set body text at weight 300 or any readable text below 12 px.
Don't add a Delivery One logo; the product name stays plain text.
